Reading List

Track your reading list: to-read, reading with progress, and finished books.

📚 To Read

📖 Reading

✅ Finished

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the book title and author, pick a status, and click Add Book.
  2. Move books between lists by changing status on each card.
  3. Adjust the progress % slider for books you are reading.
  4. Delete books you no longer want to track.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add a book?

Add a title (and optional author), then set its status. Use the progress slider for books you are currently reading.

What are the three lists?

The three status lanes are To Read, Reading, and Finished. You can change a book's status any time.

What does the progress % mean?

The number is the percentage of the book you have read — just your own estimate.

Is my reading list saved?

Yes, stored in this browser's localStorage. It stays private on this device.
